scripts.dev:linux: cargo run --features zettings-mock --manifest-path apps/zettings/Cargo.toml --no-default-features || cargo run --manifest-path apps/zettings/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:linux: pnpm -F zettings-web build && cargo build --release --manifest-path apps/zettings/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.ci:check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo check --workspace && cargo deny check
scripts.bindings: cargo test -p zettings-ipc --features export-bindings && pnpm typecheck
